_doc: The 3D and video pop-ups (docs/popups.md, docs/3d-video-popups.md): one service on skippy-core, core/popups-3d, port 7348. Quality tier: slow, patient jobs that load only while they work.

popups.name: image_to_3d

texture.description: Paint a texture onto the model (default true). False gives a bare grey shape in a fraction of the time.

shape.description: full (default): the better shape model. mini: a smaller, rougher one.

seed.description: Fixes the result, to make the same model again.

popups.description: Turns ONE attached picture of a single object into a textured 3D model (.glb) for AR, Garry's Mod props or tabletop miniatures. Works best on one object, whole and centered, on a plain background; the background is removed for you. Takes a couple of minutes.

popups.name: text_to_3d

prompt.description: The one object to make, described plainly: what it is, its shape, colours and materials. No scene, no background.

texture.description: Paint a texture onto the model (default true).

popups.description: Makes a textured 3D model (.glb) of one object from a description, for AR, Garry's Mod props or tabletop miniatures: it draws a picture of the object first, then turns that into 3D. Use image_to_3d instead when the user attached a picture. Slow: about ten minutes.

popups.name: make_video

prompt.description: What happens in the clip: the subject, the motion, the camera, the light. One shot.

seconds.description: Length, 1 to 4 seconds (default 3; about 10 minutes of work per second of clip).

popups.description: Makes a short video clip (1 to 4 seconds, mp4, no sound) from a description; an attached picture becomes its first frame and gets animated. Slow: up to an hour.
